Bounded round-four review of the current-owner banner and historical classification against PluginRegistry and the native protocol/startup script. The current banner still correctly describes nonce-free same-origin or bounded Desktop delivery and cross-origin refusal. The new top-realm launch capability does not isolate in-process plugins or grant broader execution rights. The dated threat-analysis body remains historical. TS tests execute guards/delivery shape; Rust and installed platform behavior NOT_VERIFIED.

Reviewed the #3001 round-four delivery delta: webview labels are not frame identity; startup injection requires top realm, exact shell origin and allowed label, with an explicit WebView2 subframe guard. Native entry validates a per-launch HMAC capability in constant time before per-label capacity, scheduling or credentials; the permit covers unbounded OS prompts by design. Checked transient query/no-store/no-referrer handling, report-capture redaction and fixed script errors; no IPC getter. Focused TS execution and twelve detected/restored faults cover the JS guards, URL delivery, referrer attributes and errors; VM/jsdom does not establish installed WebView behavior. Rust tests are source-reviewed only, NOT_VERIFIED on this Mac. Historical evidence remains scoped to its original revision.
